global_semantics: All atoms apply on the same full Omega; no segment-local reinterpretation is permitted in E11-v1.
A candidate composition is compatible only if it contains no frozen incompatible pair and its clean-scope conjunction checker accepts it.
Regime is mechanistic; asymptote is latent-assisted. Their flags are preserved in every envelope record.
Oracle selects among these predeclared atoms only and never creates a new signed, bound, onset, interval, rate, or shape instance after seeing the future.
envelope_rule: Enumerate all nonempty compatible subsets of selected valid canonical atoms. Retain an inclusion-maximal subset containing the intended supplied triple. Accept a task only when exactly one such maximal subset exists; otherwise deterministically redraw.
